# L3 — the FHIR artefacts

Knowledge-graph layer L3 as a NAMED SUBGRAPH of this layer, OPT-IN like `L1/` (a downstream layer lists `smart-base.smart-base-L3` in its `enableSubgraphs`), beside `L1/` (owner, 2026-11-13: 'L1..L3 as named subgraphs', issue #359). `L3/graph.json` names what it holds FROM WITHIN: its `schemas/` and, as they move in, its tools, skills and processes. It imports only from the layers below it.

Part of [SMART Base](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-base-L3`, holding `cat-harness`.

| file | what it is | used by |

| [`collab/`](collab/README.md) | The collaborative-development group of L3, OPT-IN inside the opt-in `L3/` and requiring `cat-harness.sdlc`, `L3/` itself and the level below it, whose skills its processes call (owner, 2026-11-13: L2/L3 own collab): the L3 processes that run on the work plan and the delivery process. Only this group requires sdlc; L3's schemas, skills and tools do not. A layer switches it on with `smart-base.L3-collab` in its `enableSubgraphs`. | |
